_readme: Hand corrections applied by scripts/build-catalog.mjs, keyed by product id (the id in catalog.js). Fields: dept (sidearms|longarms|shotguns|ammo|optics|gear), type (icon key), name, brand, price, priceNote, firearm (true/false), featured (true = show on the home page), lore (one-line flavor text), desc, specs {caliber, capacity, barrel, action, ...}, hide (true = leave off the site). Example: "glock-19-gen-5": { "featured": true, "lore": "Standard issue below the ice." } noPhoto (true = take its photo off the site, and off every product sharing it).
